usage.applicability: Non-OCR named-place identity ranking for source-audited public-reference cohorts before entrance binding.
usage.source_scope: Six source-audited Hong Kong named entities, 12 public reference images, 6 calibration views, and 11 evaluation views drawn from a frozen 50-image Commons library.
usage.project_application: Supply a non-OCR identity branch for the find-correct-building stage before entrance binding and temporal guidance.
usage.modifications: CLIP global reference similarity, DINOv2 pooled appearance, and mutual-patch affine consistency; OCR calls fixed at zero for the first falsifier.
usage.expected_effect: Reject wrong named entities when text is absent or unreadable, while a richer multi-facet reference bank should raise correct-entity retrieval.

evaluation.setup: Frozen zero-OCR facade identity followed by two source-disjoint multi-facet entrance-view runs.
evaluation.effect: Facade geometry removed wrong-goal confirmations without improving top-1; metadata entrance truth was invalid; human-labelled fresh views showed entrance ranking signal but scene-level identity AND entrance collapsed.
evaluation.claim_boundary: Public reference banks supply useful non-OCR identity and entrance ranking evidence, but neither scene-level identity nor filename facets establish target-to-entrance binding, exact entrance truth, navigation, or arrival.

history.change: Category membership is not visibility truth; teacher or metadata source admission cannot be promoted to evaluator truth.
Changed the successor from scene-level conjunction to proposal-context target identity; both opened entrance cohorts are closed to tuning.
